data.name: Bismaan
data.gender_notes: Bismaan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'b-s-m' which means 'to seek refuge' or 'to ask for protection'. This name signifies seeking protection and guidance from Allah. The name Bismaan carries the meaning “Seeking protection from Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bismaan usually hope their child will grow to embody seeking protection from allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies devotion and submission to Allah. It is a reminder to always seek His guidance and protection in all aspects of life.
data.etymology: Bismaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Seeking protection from Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bismaan total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: بسمان
in_arabic.meaning: المسمى بالبسمان، هو المسمى الذي يذكر في القرآن الكريم، والذي يعني الحصان الحسن
in_arabic.long_meaning: يعد اسم بسمان من أسماء الله الحسنى التي ذكرت في القرآن الكريم، ويُرمز إلى الحصان الحسن الذي يُعتبر رمزًا للصبر والصبرة، كما يُعتبر هذا الاسم رمزًا للقوة والجلالة، ويُذكَر في القرآن الكريم في صورة مشبّهة، حيث يقول الله تعالى: ( وَإِذْ قَالَ اللَّهُ يَا عِسْرَاءُ إِنِّي مُبَارَكٌ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنِّي نَصَحْتُكُمْ لِأَن لِيَ وَلَوْ أَنَّكُمْ تُدْرِكُونَ ) [القصص: 3].
